subsequentFinding: A new dedicated-host run reproduced the same digest pair with identical numerical data and only environment.machine differing. See docs/en/pn-repeatability.md; this original owner report is retained as historical context.
reportedCause: The project owner reports that another Codex subagent modified logs during concurrent work and corrupted some emitted values; similar incidents were observed in other projects.
disposition: Remove this historical incident from the Windows MVP blocker list based on the owner's external-interference report, not on a solver fix or a forensic reconstruction of the missing originals.
